name: Employer-Sponsored Work and Residence Permit

requirements.blocker_text: The Employment Agency of the Republic of North Macedonia (ESARM/AV) issues work permits enabling an employer to conclude an employment contract with a foreigner. Under 2025 amendments (effective 26 Sept 2025), the employer must register the employment with ESARM within 30 days (previously 90), and provide a notarized statement guaranteeing the foreign worker's stay-related costs and potential removal expenses. A single criminal-record certificate (from the country of residence, issued within the prior 12 months) now suffices, down from requiring one from both the citizenship and residence countries. Temporary residence for employment purposes is typically granted for around 1 year, renewable. Seconded employees under contracts between unaffiliated companies face a 180-day cap (extendable to 1 year for designated strategic-partner entities). The Employment Agency's labor-market opinion and quota rules are waived entirely for government-designated 'strategic projects.'
requirements.fix_path: Secure a Macedonian employment contract, have the employer register it with ESARM within 30 days, and obtain the temporary residence permit for employment.

evidence_required.document: Criminal record certificate (country of residence, within 12 months)

outcome.duration_length: approximately 1 year, renewable (180 days for unaffiliated-company secondments, extendable to 1 year for strategic partners)

sources.title: Karanovic & Partners (law firm) -- summary of North Macedonia's 2025 amendments to the Law on Foreigners governing temporary residence and employment: documentation simplification, 30-day employer registration deadline, labor-market-test waivers for strategic projects, secondment caps

Agencija za Vrabotuvanje (Employment Agency of the Republic of North Macedonia) -- confirms ESARM's role issuing work permits and exempt categories (family of citizens, ethnic Macedonian descendants, refugees)
